name: Exp_Elliott_Wave_Oscillator
summary: This EA trades based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator (EWO), which is calculated as the difference between two smoothed moving averages of different periods. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于艾略特波浪振荡器(EWO)进行交易，EWO由两条不同周期的平滑移动平均线之差计算得出。当振荡器从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于艾略特波浪振荡器，即短周期与长周期平滑均线的差值，本质上是一个动量类指标。入场条件为：当振荡器值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当振荡器值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件为：当信号反转时平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose为true时），同时设置了固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金、余额、含亏损余额和固定手数等四种方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例，默认为0.1，并支持多种保证金计算模式。策略使用了两层平滑算法，第一层为SMA周期5，第二层为JJMA周期35，可通过枚举选择多达10种平滑方法。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Elliott Wave Oscillator, which measures the difference between a short-period and a long-period smoothed moving average — essentially a momentum-type indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the oscillator turns upward from a declining state (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position opens when the oscillator turns downward from a rising state (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions: positions close on signal reversal when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are enabled, plus fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels are applied. Position sizing supports four margin modes — free margin, balance, loss-free margin, and loss-balance — as well as a fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter (default 0.1) with configurable margin calculation modes. The strategy employs a dual-layer smoothing algorithm with a first-stage SMA of period 5 and a second-stage JJMA of period 35, with up to 10 smoothing methods selectable via enumeration.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

pros: 使用艾略特波浪振荡器，融合动量与趋势判断，逻辑清晰
支持10种平滑算法，参数灵活性高，可适配不同市场
同时提供止损止盈和信号反转平仓双重出场机制
支持多种资金管理模式，仓位控制灵活
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复交易
pros_en: Uses Elliott Wave Oscillator combining momentum and trend judgment with clear logic
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms with high parameter flexibility for different markets
Provides dual exit mechanisms: fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit plus signal reversal closing
Supports multiple money management modes for flexible position sizing
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar
cons: 默认止损1000点/止盈2000点过大，对大多数货币对不实际
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号
没有持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加
信号逻辑仅依赖3个K线的振荡器值比较，过于简单
缺乏过滤条件如趋势确认、波动率过滤等辅助判断
cons_en: Default StopLoss 1000 / TakeProfit 2000 points are unrealistically large for most currency pairs
No spread filter — may generate false signals in high-spread environments
No position check — may open duplicate positions causing overlapping exposure
Signal logic relies on only 3-bar oscillator comparison, overly simplistic
Lacks supplementary filters like trend confirmation or volatility filtering
improvements: 增加持仓检查，防止同一方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤和波动率过滤以减少虚假信号
优化止损止盈默认值，使其更符合实际市场波动
增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向确认），避免震荡市中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add position check to prevent duplicate opening in the same direction
Add spread filter and volatility filter to reduce false signals
Optimize default StopLoss/TakeProfit values to match actual market volatility
Add trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction confirmation) to avoid frequent trades in ranging markets

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致同方向仓位叠加，放大风险
固定止损止盈点数未考虑市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能不足
信号反转即平仓可能在震荡市中频繁止损
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may cause overlapping positions in the same direction, amplifying risk
Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit points do not account for market volatility changes, may be insufficient in extreme conditions
Closing on signal reversal may cause frequent stop-outs in choppy markets
